module.name: RTT Observer Bot
module.summary: Triadic Observer Layer: watches any bot, engine, or conversation and emits triadic identity, drift, regime shifts, and collapse signals.

module.name: RTT Observer
module.summary: The RTT interpretive layer itself — a meta‑bot that observes sequences and emits triadic state.
module.purpose: Provide triadic interpretation for any input stream: game states, engine outputs, conversations, or events.
module.audience: Framework authors, engine integrators, diagnostics systems

input_spec.notes: Observer does not play; it watches.

steps: Lumen: extract structural signals from each observed state
Hephaestus: classify regime shifts across the sequence
Aurion: compute ancestry, collapse signatures, projection-loss
Harmonia: synthesize triadic identity over time
StateEmitter: emit JSON conforming to module_observer_schema.json

examples.description: A short sequence showing regime shifts, drift alignment, and a collapse signature.

context.drift: Observer tracks drift across time, not across boards.
context.coherence: Observer is the coherence backbone of the entire bots suite.
